summary: Candidate D v4 successfully removes all forty-four reviewed route-like marks, preserves the false-positive tree and every protected feature, and introduces no visible seam. It is a safe base for v5, but not a golden reference because the mountain zone still lacks readable broad relief.
required_changes: Change only the mountain relief substrate: add irregular, low-contrast, strictly plan-view massif and slope hierarchy without dark ridge outlines, contour loops, dashes, pseudo-writing, scenic faces, or changes to roads, cities, fields, trees, rocks, and the repaired targets.
